nomination.name: StarFoot 1.0.22: Touch shooting, Manager difficulty, fast academy
nomination.description: StarFoot is a football (soccer) career game by a solo indie developer from Türkiye. It is two careers in one: rise from a street match to world legend as a player, then take over a club as manager. Players control the key moments of every match themselves, and the game has no energy timers or subscriptions, only optional one-time purchases. Version 1.0.22 adds a second, physics-based shooting style called Touch: pull back to aim, then tap a spot on a close-up ball to choose curl or a chip, so every free kick can bend around the wall. Manager mode gets Easy, Medium and Hard difficulty levels, and a new fast academy option lets players skip through childhood faster while long-career fans keep the full experience. A free in-app event, The Comeback Challenge, invites everyone to turn around a 0-2 deficit as manager. StarFoot is available in 10 languages and every club and player name is fictional.
nomination.notes: Solo indie developer from Türkiye. Happy to provide additional assets, a promo video or a TestFlight build.
